_comment: Task router. 'read' = required before changing code; '@module' = module doc(s) for the paths you will touch (resolve with: uadr.py route <type> --path <file>). 'consider' = read only if the stated condition applies. 'skills' = load only when a workflow step needs the technique. Missing docs are skipped, not blockers.

feature.when: Build a capability that does not exist yet

consider.docs/architecture/overview.md: the change spans more than one module

feature.approval: New external dependency, new module, or public contract change

enhancement.when: Change or extend behaviour of an existing feature

consider.docs/development/coding-standards.md: you have not worked in this module's language this session

enhancement.approval: Breaking change to a public contract or stored data

bugfix.when: Observed behaviour differs from intended behaviour

consider..agent/memory/known-issues.md: the symptom may be a known limitation

bugfix.approval: Fix requires a data repair or a public contract change

refactor.when: Improve structure without changing observable behaviour
refactor.approval: Moving code across module boundaries or changing public interfaces

architecture-change.when: Change module boundaries, cross-cutting patterns, technology choices, or system topology

consider.docs/architecture/data-flow-and-integrat: data paths or external systems are affected

architecture-change.approval: ALWAYS: an accepted ADR is required before implementation

api.when: Add or change an externally consumed interface (HTTP, RPC, events, CLI, library API)

consider.docs/security/security.md: the interface handles authentication, authorisation, or personal data
consider.docs/development/coding-standards.md: naming or error conventions are unclear

api.approval: Breaking change, removal, or new unauthenticated interface

database.when: Change schema, migrations, indexes, or stored data shape

consider.docs/operations/deployment.md: the migration needs deploy ordering or downtime
consider.docs/architecture/data-flow-and-integrat: other systems read the affected data

database.approval: ALWAYS before running against any shared or production database; ALWAYS for destructive changes

dependency-upgrade.when: Add, upgrade, replace, or remove a third-party dependency or runtime

consider.docs/architecture/overview.md: the dependency is a framework or runtime

dependency-upgrade.approval: New dependency, major version upgrade, or licence change

tests.when: Add or repair automated tests without changing production behaviour

security-review.when: Assess or fix a security weakness

consider.docs/security/security.md: it exists (project threat model and controls)

security-review.approval: Changing authentication, authorisation, cryptography, or disclosure of a vulnerability

performance.when: Measure and improve speed, throughput, or resource use
performance.approval: Adding caches or infrastructure, or trading correctness guarantees for speed

pr-review.when: Review a proposed change without authoring it

consider.docs/development/coding-standards.md: style or convention findings are in scope
consider.docs/index.md: the change may contradict a recorded decision (see its decisions section)

pr-review.approval: Approving or merging on behalf of a human

production-incident.when: Something is wrong in a deployed environment
production-incident.approval: ALWAYS for any action in production (access, restart, rollback, data change, deploy)

onboard-existing-repo.when: Mode B: adapt an existing codebase to this framework
onboard-existing-repo.approval: Merging or replacing existing instruction files; any change outside framework and docs paths

init-greenfield.when: Mode A: start a new project on this framework
init-greenfield.approval: Technology stack and architecture choices (record as ADRs)
